profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Spacex
profile.summary: I'm a well-rounded platform engineer with five years of experience delivering creative and robust technical solutions for social change.

positions.title: Platform Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led technical operations of the platform team and serve as the final point of escalation for majority of platform’s resources including but not limited to application deployment, Ansible, AWS, Consul, monitoring (Prometheus), Nomad, Terraform, and Vault
- Lessened platform’s operating expense by mid-6 figures by architecting and implementing migration plan for Hashicorp Nomad, Consul, and Vault from enterprise to open source within one week
- Automated storage of 300 GB/day of Postgresql logs in S3 via Python, Gitlab CI, and Docker allowing for security team to maintain compliance with SOC2/HITRUST
- Reduced the number of initial configuration-related tickets by 95% by delivering 4 tech talks on standardized application development in Ruby on Rails, Gitlab CI, Docker, and Nomad
- Ensured seamless transition from Hashicorp Consul KV to Hashicorp Vault KV as project lead by implementing initial build-out of product and developed a Python integration and unit tests that is used in all deploys of applications 
- Wrote Ruby on Rails metrics exporters to deliver Prometheus metrics on Gitlab, various AWS services, Nomad, and Bugsnag and generated dashboards for application development teams
- Spearheaded cross-department partnerships between IT, Platform, and Security teams and implemented trainings on Git, Terraform, and Prometheus resulting in resolution of critical security vulnerabilities within a week, reduction of IT team’s labor by 10 hours/week from adoption of Ansible to automate Windows Updates and integration of Platform’s stack into other teams’ workflow
- Wrote a blog post: https://medium.com/omada-health-tech/standardization-self-service-7a72e5355706

positions.title: Linux System Administrator
positions.description:
- Architected and built the system running configurations in Ansible to administer at scale which led to an estimated 90% decline in outages resulting from increased stability
- Administered over 200 physical Ubuntu servers for Drexel University’s computer science department for use by over 700 faculty, staff, researchers, and students each year
- Initiated and conducted long-term strategic planning through iterative methods testing for multiple large-scale departmental restructuring, including 3 server rooms moves, the merger of IT and Computer Science departments’ resources, the upgrade of hard/software of a 512 TB Ceph storage cluster, and the elimination of 15 redundant servers
- Increased users’ support request count by 10 times through cultivating hundreds of positive in-person client relationships and creating effective communication channels through targeted user engagement
